vendors.title: Vendor Management
vendors.desc: Manage wafer vendors and data format templates
vendors.helpNote: All row and column numbers start from 1 (A=1, B=2, C=3...)
vendors.helpLowerLimitRow: Row containing spec lower limits (Spec Min)
vendors.helpUpperLimitRow: Row containing spec upper limits (Spec Max)
vendors.helpElectricalStartCol: Column number where electrical parameters begin
vendors.helpWaferIdCol: Column number of the Wafer ID
vendors.helpBinCol: Column number of the BIN value
vendors.helpProductIdCol: Column for Product ID, if present in the file
vendors.helpLotIdCol: Column for Lot ID, if present in the file
vendors.helpFixedDieCount: Fixed die count per wafer, if consistent across wafers
vendors.helpProductIdCell: Fixed cell for Product ID (row,col), e.g. "2,2" = row 2 col B. Use when product is in metadata, not data rows
vendors.helpLotIdCell: Fixed cell for Lot ID (row,col), e.g. "4,2" = row 4 col B. Use when lot is in metadata, not data rows
vendors.diagramProductLot: Product ID Col = A(1), Lot ID Col = B(2)

vendors.siteNoTemplate: {{site}} has no usable template; uploads from that site will fail

rules.noRules: No review rules for this product

wizard.title: Smart Template Detection
wizard.introText: Upload a sample CP file. The header, limit rows, electrical columns and wafer-id source are detected automatically; adjust them by clicking on the sheet, then dry-run before saving.
wizard.useAi: Use on-premise AI for semantic fields
wizard.pickRoleHint: Pick a field on the right, then click its position in the sheet
wizard.clickToAssign: Click, then select in the sheet
wizard.srcHint_column: Every data row carries its own wafer ID. Use when one file holds several wafers.
wizard.srcHint_cell: The wafer ID sits in one fixed cell and applies to the whole file. Use for one-wafer-per-file exports.
wizard.srcHint_label: Find a given piece of text (e.g. “Wafer number”) and take the value beside it. More reliable than a fixed address when that row moves between files.
wizard.srcHint_filename: The file has no wafer ID inside; take it from the file name. Only files like this need a naming convention.
wizard.srcHint_single: The whole file is one wafer and carries no wafer ID at all.
wizard.dryRunHint: Check the template really reads data before saving
wizard.requiredMissing: Required, and not found in the file — set it manually
wizard.conflict: The verifier disagrees on “{{field}}”: we read {{ours}}, it read {{theirs}}
wizard.clickHint: Click in the sheet: a cell to say what it is, a row number or column header to assign it
wizard.nothingSelected: Click a cell, row number or column header on the left
wizard.noOptions: No usable value found in this cell
wizard.filenameFallback: No product model inside the file
wizard.filenameHint: Extract it from the file name instead. Only files like this need a naming convention; other vendors are unaffected.
wizard.statsNoAiNeeded: Rules were confident throughout; no AI call was needed
wizard.dropHere: Drop a CP sample file here
wizard.orClick: or click to choose a file
wizard.useAiHint: When the rules are unsure, an on-premise model fills in the semantic fields. Nothing leaves the network.
wizard.mappingHint: Edit a value directly, or select a field then click its position in the sheet
wizard.armField: Click, then pick the position in the sheet
wizard.armedHint2: Now click the position in the sheet
wizard.waferNotFound: No wafer ID in this file. Choose how to obtain it:
wizard.cellAddressHint: B4 or 4,2 — or click the cell in the sheet
wizard.labelTextHint: The value beside this text is used, so the row may move between files.
wizard.historyAfterSave: History starts once the template is saved
wizard.noSamplesYet: The sample is kept when you save the template
wizard.waferExplain: The wafer ID decides which wafer each measurement belongs to. Without it, yield, SPC and review cannot line up.
wizard.metaExplain: The product model selects which review rules apply; the lot ID keeps a lot's wafers together.
wizard.reDetectIntro: Uploading a new sample re-detects the layout, replacing the current values. The change is recorded in the history.
wizard.versionTip: Current version — see the history for per-version diffs
